subject: Fix memory error in networking unittest (#1697)
reason: The change edits only src/unit/test_networking.c, adding `c->repl_data->ref_repl_buf_node = NULL;` to two unit tests' cleanup so the test harness does not reference freed replication-buffer blocks. It is a fix to the unit test code itself, compiled only into the unittest binary; no server, command, replication, or tool behaviour changes, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or exercise it.
